cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.14)
project(cyrene_quickjs LANGUAGES C CXX)
if(ANDROID)
  set(BRIDGE_NAME fastdev_quickjs_runtime)
elseif(WIN32)
  set(BRIDGE_NAME quickjs_c_bridge)
else()
  set(BRIDGE_NAME quickjs_c_bridge_plugin)
endif()
add_library(${BRIDGE_NAME} SHARED
  libfastdev_quickjs_runtime.cpp
  quickjs/dtoa.c quickjs/libregexp.c quickjs/libunicode.c quickjs/quickjs.c)
target_compile_features(${BRIDGE_NAME} PRIVATE cxx_std_17)
set_target_properties(${BRIDGE_NAME} PROPERTIES
  C_STANDARD 11 C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON
  C_VISIBILITY_PRESET hidden CXX_VISIBILITY_PRESET hidden)
if(MSVC)
  target_compile_options(${BRIDGE_NAME} PRIVATE /utf-8)
  target_compile_options(${BRIDGE_NAME} PRIVATE $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:C>:/experimental:c11atomics>)
  target_compile_definitions(${BRIDGE_NAME} PRIVATE _CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN _WIN32_WINNT=0x0601)
else()
  target_compile_definitions(${BRIDGE_NAME} PRIVATE _GNU_SOURCE)
  target_compile_options(${BRIDGE_NAME} PRIVATE -funsigned-char)
  find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
  target_link_libraries(${BRIDGE_NAME} PRIVATE m Threads::Threads ${CMAKE_DL_LIBS})
endif()
if(ANDROID)
  target_link_libraries(${BRIDGE_NAME} PRIVATE log)
  target_link_options(${BRIDGE_NAME} PRIVATE "-Wl,-z,max-page-size=16384")
endif()
